title: Understanding Model Variance
text: When a model is overfitting, it means it's too complex and captures noise in the training data. Think about how you can simplify the model or make it less sensitive to the training data.

title: Role of Lambda in Ridge Regression
text: In ridge regression, the parameter lambda controls the strength of the penalty on large coefficients. Consider how changing lambda might affect the model's complexity and variance.

title: Effect of Increasing Lambda
text: What happens to the model's variance if you increase lambda in ridge regression?

title: Balancing Bias and Variance
text: Reducing variance often involves increasing bias. Think about how you can achieve a balance between bias and variance to improve model performance.
